motion.name: price-card-hang
motion.purpose: The predicted sales card drops into place once.

components.name: Store Question
components.description: Painted panel opening each tab with the owner's question.
components.html:
How much will we sell tomorrow?

Supervised learning.
components.css: .ds-question { background: #c8202f; color: #fffdf2; padding: 32px; border-radius: 8px; } .ds-question h2 { margin: 0; font-family: 'Bowlby One', Impact, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; } .ds-question p { margin: 8px 0 0; font-family: Barlow, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; }

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: Each tab owns one painted color for its question. Chart series use only red, blue, and green, in that order.

rules.name: The Reading Rule
rules.body: Bowlby One is for what is glanced at, never for what is read at length.

dos: Do open every tab with the store owner's question.
donts: Don't add chart libraries. Charts stay Streamlit built-ins.
